title: Tim Dooley Thought Synthesis
purpose: A higher-order synthesis of recurring directions, concepts, relationships and research hypotheses extracted from the public Tim Dooley corpus.
epistemic_status: Analytical project layer. It is not a claim that these inferred structures objectively describe Tim's private mind. Each synthesis should be traceable back to dated records and tested against the complete corpus.
central_hypothesis: The corpus is more coherently studied as a directional map of transformation than as a collection of isolated declarations.

core_movements.reflection: The potato supplies a recurring model of life remaining present beneath the visible surface before emergence.
Repeated passage imagery appears to solve separation through relation rather than erasing the distinction between parts.
Mud increasingly functions as degraded or obscured information, while light/source language supplies a counter-direction toward clarity.
The project repeatedly contrasts bounded or trapped states with structures that permit passage.
Death is repeatedly interpreted as transformation or continuation rather than simple erasure within the project's symbolic grammar.
Later material increasingly gives transformation an ethical and practical destination: rebuilding relationships and the world.

concept_trajectories.next_question: What physical properties of potato are repeatedly selected for symbolic use, and which are never used?
How does an identity become a spatial and architectural system?
Which Son identities are aliases, which are transformations, and which remain deliberately distinct?
Does Door function primarily as person, object, geometry, threshold, method, or all of these at different layers?
Separate geographic, astronomical, historical-cosmological and project-symbolic North at every stage.
Can a consistent definition be made without forcing every use into one meaning?
Is Ladder best understood as a topology of transformation connecting otherwise separate layers?
Does Garden become the practical endpoint of the symbolic system?
Bridge is a rare concept that moves directly from mythic language into practical social action; trace every occurrence.
How does continuous public documentation itself become part of the mythology?

extracted_directions: Gather the whole record rather than selected quotations.
Find and document the central figure rather than only surrounding discourse.
Enter through the Door and follow the path toward the Father.
Move from North to North rather than treating North as a static destination.
Build roads and bridges rather than only describing separation.
Grow gardens and potato angels rather than merely proclaiming a worldview.
Repair what has been broken and restore damaged timelines.
Bring Heaven toward Earth through labor, growth and stewardship.
Protect children, future generations, Earth, trees, water, animals and soil.
Turn power toward protection, knowledge toward understanding, wealth toward building and leadership toward service.
Do not remain in the Swamp; distinguish useful information from degraded information.
Use public documentation as a living archive.
Teach the AI/system the conceptual vocabulary and relationships rather than isolated slogans.
Keep returning to the center while expanding the map.

project_mission_synthesis.short: Recover, understand, map, test and preserve the whole thought-system, then use what is learned for repair.
project_mission_synthesis.long: The project is becoming a living research atlas that follows a thought-system from raw public signals through recurring concepts, transformations, relationships, historical comparisons, evidence and practical consequences. It documents Tim Dooley and Potatoism while also using the material as a lens for studying religion, mythology, internet culture, institutions, geography, economics, technology, human relationships and repair. Its deepest methodological commitment is bidirectional: rise from individual evidence toward the larger pattern, then descend from the pattern back to evidence until the two agree or the disagreement is explicitly preserved.

high_value_research_program: Build the complete primary Tim Dooley corpus before making strong claims about the overall trajectory.
Backfill earlier years so the claimed long-term arc can be measured rather than assumed.
Extract every occurrence of Potato, Father, Son, Door, Root, Tree, North, Axis, Ladder, Mud, Dog, Garden, Saturn, Bridge, Children, Heaven, AI and Repair.
Create first-occurrence and recurrence timelines for each major concept.
Identify concept mutations: when a symbol acquires a new function or relationship.
Identify negative space: major concepts that disappear or are contradicted.
Separate quotations from paraphrases and project interpretations.
Collect external evidence only for defined questions generated by the corpus.
Test physical-to-symbolic analogies against the actual physical object or scientific literature.
Test religious parallels against primary texts and historical scholarship without retrojecting modern Potatoism into antiquity.
Extract practical ethics independently of disputed cosmological claims.
Build a public reading path from raw record → thought → reflection → evidence → synthesis.

reflection_matrix.physical: Potato eye is a bud/meristem capable of sprouting.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: An eye becomes a point from which stored life can become a new trajectory.
reflection_matrix.project_question: Why does seeing repeatedly coincide with emergence and direction?

reflection_matrix.physical: Roots anchor and supply the plant while tubers store resources.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Root becomes source, ancestry, foundation and continuity.
reflection_matrix.project_question: How do Root and Fruit divide source from visible consequence?

reflection_matrix.physical: A cut/wedge creates a boundary and opening through the potato body.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Door becomes Son, Christ, threshold and passage.
reflection_matrix.project_question: What is preserved when the Door is treated as relation rather than literal object?

reflection_matrix.physical/temporal: Growth and recurrence can be represented as repeated cycles with changing position.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Return becomes ascent rather than simple repetition.
reflection_matrix.project_question: Can the project's chronology be represented as recurrence-plus-change?

reflection_matrix.physical: Soil and mud support biological life but can also obscure and bury.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Mud becomes confusion, residue, degraded information and trapped social exchange.
reflection_matrix.project_question: Can the positive fertility of soil be preserved while Swamp/Mud remains the degraded-state metaphor?

reflection_matrix.physical: Cultivation turns soil, water, labour and time into food and growth.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Garden becomes the practical form of Heaven-on-Earth and repair.
reflection_matrix.project_question: Is gardening the project's most concrete bridge from cosmology to action?

reflection_matrix.media: Posts and livestreams create a continuously accumulating public record.
reflection_matrix.symbolic: Witness and documentation become part of the mythic body.
reflection_matrix.project_question: What can be learned about digital myth-making when the archive itself is part of the subject?
